```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Package installation and loading
required_packages <- c('readr', 'ggpubr', 'stringr', 'gtsummary', 'flextable', 
                       'dplyr', 'tidyr', 'scales', 'pROC', 'ggstatsplot', 
                       'ggeffects', 'ggimage', 'cowplot', 'ggsci', 'lme4', 'lmerTest',
                       'pals', 'forcats')

for (name in required_packages) {
  if (!require(name, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(name, dep = TRUE)
    if (!require(name, character.only = TRUE)) stop("Package not found")
  }
}

# Figures are written to plots/ (ggsave does not create the folder)
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r functions}
# Function to load and combine datasets
load_and_combine <- function(path_prefix, seq_length_label) {
  df_val <- read_csv(paste0(path_prefix, "_val_", seq_length_label, ".csv"))
  df_test <- read_csv(paste0(path_prefix, "_test_", seq_length_label, ".csv"))
  df_train <- read_csv(paste0(path_prefix, "_train_", seq_length_label, ".csv"))
  
  df_combined <- rbind(df_val, df_test, df_train)
  df_combined$seq_length <- seq_length_label
  return(df_combined)
}

# Function to prepare plotting variables
prepare_plot_vars <- function(df) {
  df$`Sequence Length` <- factor(df$seq_length, 
                                  levels = c("training", "block", "full"),
                                  labels = c("20s random sequence", "25s task synchronized", "Full sequence"))
  
  df$`Population` <- factor(df$split, 
                            levels = c("train", "val", "test"),
                            labels = c("FINA: training set", "FINA: test set", "RAW independent set"))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      ),
      # Absolute errors
      wae = abs(pred_worry - label_worry),
      nae = abs(pred_neutral - label_neutral),
      rae = abs(pred_reappraisal - label_reappraisal),
      aae = (wae + nae + rae) / 3
    )
  
  return(df)
}

# Function to calculate AUCs safely
safe_auc <- function(response, predictor, quiet = TRUE) {
  tryCatch({
    as.numeric(auc(response, predictor, quiet = quiet))
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

# Function to find local maxima with constraints
find_local_maxima <- function(x, y, n_max = 3, min_distance = 5) {
  if(length(y) < 3) return(data.frame())
  
  peaks <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == -2) + 1
  peaks <- c(peaks, length(y))
  
  if(length(peaks) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  peak_values <- y[peaks]
  sorted_peaks <- peaks[order(peak_values, decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  selected_peaks <- c()
  for(peak in sorted_peaks) {
    if(length(selected_peaks) >= n_max) break
    if(length(selected_peaks) == 0 || all(abs(x[peak] - x[selected_peaks]) >= min_distance)) {
      selected_peaks <- c(selected_peaks, peak)
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    timepoint = x[selected_peaks],
    shap_value = y[selected_peaks]
  )
}

# Function to prepare SHAP network data
prepare_shap_network_data <- function(df, class_label, split_filter = "test", times_max_threshold = 0.1, ids = NULL) {
  shap_col_pattern <- paste0("shap_network_", class_label)
  
  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(split == split_filter) %>%
    mutate(
      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(class_label == "" | true_class == class_label) %>%
    select(id1, id2, timepoint, contains(shap_col_pattern), rate, pswq_total, age, sex, hars_score, rsq_total, true_class) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains(shap_col_pattern), 
                 names_to = "network", 
                 values_to = "shap_value") %>%
    group_by(id1, id2, timepoint) %>%
    mutate(
      network = gsub(shap_col_pattern, "", network), 
      shap_value = abs(shap_value), 
      timepoint = timepoint + 1,
      shap_value_scaled = (shap_value - min(shap_value)) / (max(shap_value) - min(shap_value))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(network, timepoint) %>%
    mutate(mean_shap = mean(shap_value_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    mutate(is_max_mean = mean_shap == max(mean_shap, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(network) %>%
    mutate(times_max = mean(is_max_mean)) %>%
    ungroup() 
  
  if (is.null(ids)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      filter(times_max >= times_max_threshold)
  }
  else{
    top_networks <- plot_data %>%
      distinct(network, times_max) %>%
      arrange(desc(times_max)) %>%
      slice(ids) %>%
      pull(network)
    
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      filter(network %in% top_networks)
  }
  
  return(plot_data)
}
```

```{r data_loading}
# Load all datasets
df_block <- load_and_combine("./data/export", "block")
df_full <- load_and_combine("./data/export", "full")
df_training <- load_and_combine("./data/export", "training")

# Combine all datasets
df <- rbind(df_training, df_block, df_full)

# Load SHAP data
df_val_block_with_shap <- read_csv("./data/export_val_block_with_shap.csv")
df_test_block_with_shap <- read_csv("./data/export_test_block_with_shap.csv")
df_block_withshap <- rbind(df_val_block_with_shap, df_test_block_with_shap)

# Clean environment
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("df", "df_block_withshap", lsf.str())))

# Prepare data
df <- prepare_plot_vars(df)

if(!"true_class" %in% colnames(df_block_withshap)) {
  df_block_withshap <- df_block_withshap %>%
    mutate(
      true_class = case_when(
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_worry ~ "worry",
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_neutral ~ "neutral", 
        pmax(label_worry, label_neutral, label_reappraisal) == label_reappraisal ~ "reappraisal"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r lmer_analysis, fig.height=14, fig.width=6}
# Calculate blockwise MAE
mae_data <- df %>%
  filter(seq_length == "block", split == "test") %>%
  group_by(id1, block_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mae = mean(abs(aae), na.rm = TRUE),
    rating = (first(rating)-1)/(5-1),
    pswq_total = (first(pswq_total)-16)/(80-16),
    rsq_total = (first(rsq_total)-22)/(88-22),
    hars_score = first(hars_score)/56,
    true_class = first(true_class),
    age = (first(age)-50)/50,
    sex = first(sex),
    common_id = first(common_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Class = factor(true_class, 
                   levels = c("neutral", "worry", "reappraisal"),
                   labels = c("Neutral", "Worry", "Reappraisal")),
    Age = age,
    PSWQ = pswq_total,
    RSQ = rsq_total,
    HARS = hars_score,
    Rating = rating,
    Subject = id1
  )

# Run mixed effects model
mae_data$common_id <- is.na(mae_data$common_id)
model <- lmer(mae ~ Age + Sex + PSWQ + RSQ + Rating + Rating*Class + RSQ*Class + HARS*Class + 
              PSWQ*Class + Sex*Class + Age*Class + Class + HARS + common_id + (1|Subject),
              data = mae_data)

summary(model)
anova(model)
g <- ggcoefstats(model, effects = "fixed", digits="signif3", exclude.intercept=TRUE, 
            sort="ascending", only.significant=TRUE, xlab = "Estimate", ylab = "Terms")

ggsave("plots/figure_model_mae.png", plot = g, width = 4, height = 12, dpi = 300)
g
```

```{r mae_plots, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
tmp <- df %>% 
  gather("ae_type", "ae_value", aae, wae, nae, rae) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(ae_type, 
                           levels = c("aae", "wae", "nae", "rae"),
                           labels = c("Overall", "Worry", "Neutral", "Reappraisal")))

g_overall <- grouped_ggbetweenstats(
  data = tmp[tmp$Condition == "Overall",],
  x = `Sequence Length`,
  y = ae_value,

    ylab("Absolute error (log10 scale)")
  )
)

ggsave("plots/figure_mae_overall.png", plot = g_overall, width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r shap_temporal, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
tmp <- df_block_withshap %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint) + 1,
    shap_all = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_")) %>% select(-starts_with("shap_network")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
      rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_worry = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_worry_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                 rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_neutral = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_neutral_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                   rescale(to = c(0, 1)),
    shap_reappraisal = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("shap_roi_reappraisal_")) %>% abs(), na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                       rescale(to = c(0, 1))
  ) %>% 
  gather("shap_condition", "shap_value", shap_worry, shap_neutral, shap_reappraisal, shap_all) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(shap_condition, 
                      levels = c("shap_all", "shap_worry", "shap_neutral", "shap_reappraisal"),
                      labels = c("Overall", "Worry", "Neutral", "Reappraisal")),
    Population = factor(split, 
                       levels = c("train", "val", "test"),
                       labels = c("FINA: training set", "FINA: test set", "RAW independent set"))
  ) %>%
  select(timepoint, shap_value, Condition, Population)

mean_data <- tmp %>%
  group_by(Population, Condition, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_shap = mean(shap_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

maxima_data <- mean_data %>%
  group_by(Population, Condition) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>%
  do(find_local_maxima(.$timepoint, .$mean_shap, 3, 5)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggline(tmp, x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value", color = "Condition", add = "mean_ci", 
       facet.by = "Population", numeric.x.axis = TRUE, palette = "lancet") + 
  geom_point(data = maxima_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = shap_value + 0.005, color = Condition), 
             shape = 8, size = 3) +
  xlab("Time (s) task synchronized") +
  ylab("smaShap") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1, size = 6))

ggsave("plots/figure_timing.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r auc_analysis, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
tmp <- df %>%
  group_by(id1, id2, `Sequence Length`) %>%
  mutate(
    auc_worry_all = safe_auc(true_class == "worry", pred_worry),
    auc_neutral_all = safe_auc(true_class == "neutral", pred_neutral),
    auc_reappraisal_all = safe_auc(true_class == "reappraisal", pred_reappraisal),
    auc_worry_neutral = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("worry", "neutral")] == "worry",
                                pred_worry[true_class %in% c("worry", "neutral")]),
    auc_worry_reappraisal = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("worry", "reappraisal")] == "worry",
                                    pred_worry[true_class %in% c("worry", "reappraisal")]),
    auc_neutral_reappraisal = safe_auc(true_class[true_class %in% c("neutral", "reappraisal")] == "neutral",
                                      pred_neutral[true_class %in% c("neutral", "reappraisal")])
  ) %>% 
  gather("auc_type", "auc_value", auc_worry_all, auc_neutral_all, auc_reappraisal_all, 
         auc_worry_neutral, auc_worry_reappraisal, auc_neutral_reappraisal) %>% 
  group_by(id1, id2, `Sequence Length`, auc_type) %>%
  summarise(Population = first(Population), auc_value = mean(auc_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(auc_type, 
                           levels = c("auc_worry_all", "auc_neutral_all", "auc_reappraisal_all", 
                                     "auc_worry_neutral", "auc_worry_reappraisal", "auc_neutral_reappraisal"),
                           labels = c("Worry vs Rest", "Neutral vs Rest", "Reappraisal vs Rest", 
                                     "Worry vs Neutral", "Worry vs Reappraisal", "Neutral vs Reappraisal")))

grouped_ggbetweenstats(
  data = tmp %>% filter(`Sequence Length` == "25s task synchronized"),
  x = Population,
  y = auc_value,
  grouping.var = Condition,
  type = "parametric",
  pairwise.display = "significant",
  results.subtitle = FALSE,
  p.adjust.method = "holm",
  centrality.plotting = TRUE,
  ggplot.component = list(ylim(0.5, 1), ylab("AUC"))
)
ggsave("plots/figure_auc.png", width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```


```{r shap_summary}
df_block_withshap %>%
  filter(split == "test") %>%
  select(id1, id2, true_class, timepoint, contains("shap_network_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(contains("shap_network_"), names_to = "feature", values_to = "shap") %>%
  mutate(
    label = str_split_i(feature, "_", 3),
    network = sub("^([^_]+_){3}", "", feature)
  ) %>%
  group_by(label, network) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(label), desc(mean_abs_shap))
```

```{r shap_networks_reappraisal, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
colors <- pal_npg()(7)
network_labels <- c(
    "AnteriorHippocampus" = "Anterior Hippocampus",
    "anteriorDMN" = "Anterior Default Mode Network",
    "ASN" = "Anterior Salience Network",
    "Auditory" = "Auditory Cortex",
    "BasalGanglia" = "Basal Ganglia",
    "BilateralInsula" = "Bilateral Insula",
    "Cerebellum" = "Cerebellum",
    "DAN" = "Dorsal Attention Network",
    "FrontoLimbic" = "Frontolimbic Network",
    "Fusiform" = "Fusiform Gyrus",
    "left_ECN" = "Left Executive Control Network",
    "Motor" = "Motor Cortex",
    "PrimaryVisual" = "Primary Visual Cortex",
    "posteriorDMN" = "Posterior Default Mode Network",
    "right_ECN" = "Right Executive Control Network",
    "SecondaryVisual" = "Secondary Visual Cortex",
    "SMA" = "Supplementary Motor Network",
    "ventralDMN" = "Ventral Default Mode Network"
  )

plot_data <- prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "worry")
plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "neutral"))
plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, "reappraisal"))

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(network = factor(network_labels[as.character(str_replace(network, "_", ""))], levels = network_labels[c("AnteriorHippocampus", "DAN", "SMA", "Motor","PrimaryVisual","SecondaryVisual","Cerebellum")]), network_color = colors[as.numeric(network)], Class = factor(str_to_title(true_class)))

col_vec <- setNames(unique(plot_data$network_color), unique(plot_data$network))
ggline(plot_data, x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value_scaled", 
       color = "network", add = "mean_ci", palette = col_vec, 
       numeric.x.axis = TRUE, facet.by = "Class") + 
  labs(x = "Time (s) task synchronized", y = "smaShap", colour = "Networks") +
  facet_wrap(~Class, nrow = 2, ncol = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25))
ggsave("plots/figure_smaShap.png", width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
library(pals)
library(forcats) 
colors <- polychrome(18)

for (label in c("worry", "neutral", "reappraisal")){
  plot_data <- prepare_shap_network_data(df_block_withshap, label, ids=1:18) %>%
    mutate(
      network = factor(network_labels[as.character(str_replace(network, "_", ""))], levels = network_labels),
      network_color = colors[as.numeric(network)]
    ) %>%
    group_by(network) %>%
    mutate(mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap_value_scaled))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap)) %>%
    mutate(
      network = fct_inorder(network),
      network_group = paste0('Group ', ntile(row_number(), 6))
    )
  
  col_vec <- setNames(unique(plot_data$network_color), unique(plot_data$network))
  
  for(grp in 1:6){
    p <- plot_data %>%
      filter(network_group == paste("Group", grp)) %>%
      ggline(x = "timepoint", y = "shap_value_scaled", color = "network", 
             add = "mean_ci", palette = col_vec, numeric.x.axis = TRUE) + 
      labs(x = "Time (s) task synchronized", y = "smaShap", 
           colour = "Networks")
    ggsave(paste0("plots/shap_", label, "_group", grp, ".png"), p, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}
```
